evidence.reason: The finding assumes the re-review diff is origin/main..head and therefore never contains a removal of src/a.ts. The supplied test code describes the opposite scenario: the comment at lines 201-203 says round 1's re-review is the seed leg `-BAD +GOOD`, and the trigger at line 206 is keyed to that seed-leg prompt. On the intended per-round pinned seed base, the prompt does contain `-export const a = "BAD"`, so the finding fires and round 2 is reached. The claim that no re-review prompt contains the `-` line is unsupported and conflicts with the test's stated seed-leg comparison.
